role: Post-policy-freeze independent research, not course demo/official table.
ordering: No policy or threshold changes on these outcomes. Every preregistered condition is run both with stock contact materials and with its listed change; same settled state at t=0, all other plant parameters, encoders, JTS seed and reference unchanged.
measurement: Actual applied 3-axis force and native scalar checked exactly at every sample using the stock per-sample norm. Four twins: no force, first only, second only, both. The original R18 diagnostics (including any batched-norm failure) remain visible. First-only post-force false rises are explicitly compared through the following placement.
attribution: 20 ms prequiet, no-target twin +/-20 ms, new edge by 320 ms. Strict case: exactly one raw and attributable rise per slot AND all originally required gates, substituting ONLY a separate exact samplewise signed/scalar proof for the old batched signed-profile gate in the separately named physical score. Report both.
retention: Any lost genuine (+5 ms allowance), extra unmatched or tool alarm loss is a regression; original R10 and actual R20 references tested. No contact-policy reactions.
